title: Expected ASX secondary listing date
gist: Glencore announced it has satisfied all ASX requirements for a Foreign Exempt Listing, with CHESS Depositary Interests (ASX:GLC) set to begin trading on 14 October 2026, giving Australian holders a local mechanism to trade Glencore shares via CDIs managed by Computershare.

insights.claim: Glencore's CHESS Depositary Interests (CDIs), each representing a beneficial interest in one Glencore ordinary share, are expected to begin trading on the ASX under ticker GLC on Wednesday, 14 October 2026, after Glencore satisfied all substantive ASX Foreign Exempt Listing requirements.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: A confirmed 14 October 2026 start date gives Australian-based investors and index funds a firm event date to prepare for adding Glencore exposure via a local, AUD-denominated listing rather than only through UK or other primary-market shares.
insights.quote: The expected first day of trading for Glencore’s CHESS Depositary Interests (CDIs) (ASX:GLC) will be on Wednesday, 14 October 2026.
insights.locator: Glencore has been notified by the Australian Securities Exchange

insights.claim: Holders of Glencore ordinary shares can request conversion into CDIs by contacting Glencore's share registries in Jersey or South Africa, with conversions subject to standard market operations and, for South African holders, compliance with Exchange Control Regulations.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: The added South African exchange-control compliance step is a friction point specific to that shareholder base that could slow conversion volumes from South Africa relative to UK-based holders around the listing date.
insights.quote: conversions subject to market standard operations and, from South Africa, subject also to compliance with Exchange Control Regulations

themes.theme: Company scale as context for the listing

insights.claim: Glencore describes itself as one of the world's largest diversified natural resource companies, producing and marketing more than 60 commodities with over 140,000 employees and contractors across more than 30 countries.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: This scale context (60+ commodities, 140,000+ employees, 30+ countries) is the backdrop against which the ASX secondary listing should be read as a distribution/access expansion for an already-major global commodities trader, not a capital-raising event.
insights.quote: Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities.
